name: Alcaldía de Ibagué
body: One-year HSTS, a permanent https redirect, a meta description on every page analyzed, and the page text right in the HTML. But the search field has only a placeholder, so screen readers announce an unnamed box.
lesson: Give every field a <label> or an aria-label. Placeholder text disappears on typing and is not a name.
summary: www.ibague.gov.co scores 78 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 26 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 20 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /portal/index.php, /portal/seccion/contenido/index.php?type=3&cnt=371, /portal/seccion/contenido/index.php?type=3&cnt=264, /portal/seccion/contenido/index.php?type=2&cnt=150 and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 325 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 1 title is shared by more than one page
fix.evidence: "Alcaldía Municipal de Ibagué - Ibagué" on /portal/index.php, /portal/seccion/contenido/index.php?type=3&cnt=371, /portal/seccion/contenido/index.php?type=3&cnt=264 and 17 more.
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /portal/index.php, /portal/seccion/contenido/index.php?type=3&cnt=371, /portal/seccion/contenido/index.php?type=3&cnt=264, /portal/seccion/contenido/index.php?type=2&cnt=150 and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking…
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.
